what: The proposed volatile-only basename allowlist includes canonical token-report.json and timing-report.json even though refresh-run-logs writes substantive run cost/timing data to those batch names
scenario_or_breakage: A CI/rebase refresh whose only real changes are updated token or timing totals is classified volatile-only, skipped, and never committed because flush_logs_post is commit-free; main then keeps stale run-log cost data without failing completeness checks
suggested_fix: Remove token-report.json and timing-report.json from the volatile-only allowlist, or skip them only after a content-aware check proves only known timestamp/elapsed noise changed
